theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ρ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ξs : Euclid P → Euclid P → MultiVector P m), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → MeasurableSet M → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 < ρ y ∧ IsOrientation m (M ∩ ball y (ρ y)) (ξs y) ∧ μHE[m] (M ∩ ball y (ρ y)) ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball y (ρ y) → C ω = ∫ x in M ∩ ball y (ρ y), ξs y x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]) → ∃ ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m, IsOrientation m M ξ ∧ (∀ y ∈ M, ∀ x ∈ M ∩ ball y (ρ y), ξ x = ξs y x) ∧ ∀ y ∈ M, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball y (ρ y) → C ω = ∫ x in M, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]
